newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria depo rates steady in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria depo rates steady in thin trade.

text.p: Bulgarian interbank deposit rates were unchanged from Thursday in thin trade on the money market, dealers said.
"Banks' liquidity is very high and demand for lev funds is low," said a dealer. Traders said that banks had enough levs to service their pending payments for the next several months.
Banks' lev liquidity improved in the past weeks due to mark sales after the introduction on July 1 of a currency board system under which the lev is pegged to the mark at a rate of 1,000.
Overnight interbank depo rates were around 4 0-4.5 percent annual, flat from Thursday. Spot week rates were steady at 5.0-5.5 percent annually.
The central bank cut its simple annual main rate to 6.96 percent from the current 9.76 percent, effective from July 14. -- Dessislava Popova, Sofia Newsroom +359-2 981 4145
